slug: 2024-10-10 Liberia sets July 2025 deadline for SIM registration linked to national ID (LTA-NIR MoU)

facts.fact: The Liberia Telecommunications Authority and the National Identification Registry signed an MoU to link SIM cards to NIR-issued IDs through biometric registration, with a 10 July 2025 deadline after which unregistered SIMs would be deactivated and completion expected by end 2026.
